title: narcissus tazetta subsp. italicus
intro: Narcissus tazetta subsp. italicus, commonly known as the Italian daffodil or Tazetta, is a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Italian daffodil include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its wound-healing properties and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus tazetta subsp. italicus include alkaloids and flavonoids, such as tazettine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
